title: Quotient compatibility of integral direct-image projection adjuncts
statement: Let ell be prime, E/Q_ell finite, f:X→Y any scheme morphism, and K any unbounded completed-integral complex. Use the prescribed finite direct-image tower and any product witness and SfIntegralDirectImage Roos triangle L [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. For every n≥0, writing c_n for the scalar-extension adjunct of its n-th projection, U_(n+1)(c_(n+1)) followed by the finite-image tower transition t_n equals the canonical restricted-reduction transition of L.obj [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower] followed by U_n(c_n). This is an equality of the specified maps in the completed-integral derived category, without completeness, constructibility, dimension, or invertibility hypotheses.

source.place: Tags 03EK, 06YY and 08TC; lem-sf-tensor-exchange-ctf-domains, proof Step 5 (quotient transitions)

proof.text: The first two maps of the distinguished Roos triangle compose to zero. Project the product endomorphism 1-s onto level n, obtaining p_(n+1) followed by t_n equal to p_n.

Compute scalar adjunctions on K-flat representatives. The consecutive quotient transition is s tensor x mapped to rho(s) tensor x, with unit x mapped to 1 tensor x. The section-normalized direct-image/restriction comparison preserves these quotient maps, also on its K-injective derived representatives.

The two restricted adjunct composites admit the same lift to the n+1 quotient coefficient category. Applying the n+1 scalar adjunction identifies them with the projection relation of the first step. Its injectivity gives equality, and localization gives the asserted square for arbitrary complexes. This does not assert faithfulness of derived restriction of scalars.

lean.statement:
theorem sfDirectImageReductionComparison_transition
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E X))
    [HasProduct (sfDirectImageTerm l E f K)] (L : SfIntegralDirectImage l E f K)
    (n : ℕ) :
    (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction.{u, u} l E Y (n + 1)).map
          (sfDirectImageReductionComparison l E f L (n + 1)) ≫
        sfDirectImageTransition l E f K n =
      (sfDerivedReductionTransition l E Y n).app L.obj ≫
        (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction.{u, u} l E Y n).map
          (sfDirectImageReductionComparison l E f L n)
